Market today: Mixed. Strong earnings from IBM and Tesla offer some tech support, but rising bond yields are a real headwind, eroding confidence in growth names like CoreWeave. This directly impacts your tech/chip heavy book.

Your holdings: SOXL (-54.06%), MUU (-29.47%), and SPAL (-26.04%) are deep in the red and flagged SELL; these leveraged ETFs decay and margin amplifies their drops. SMCI (-18.94%) is also a SELL.

Watch: Keep a close eye on bond yields; continued spikes will pressure your growth-heavy portfolio. Monitor the performance of your "SELL" positions closely.

Bottom line: Prioritize risk management on your deeply underwater, leveraged positions given the margin and yield pressure.
plays: SOXL: Consider trimming this deeply underwater, leveraged position (-54.06%) to reduce margin risk. Your stop at 200 is far from the current 103.24.
MUU/SPAL: Review these other leveraged ETFs (-29.47%, -26.04%) flagged SELL; their decay and margin use make them high-risk.
PLTU: Consider adding to your profitable PLTU position (ACCUMULATE 8/12) at scanner entry 63.19-63.03, stop 62.13, if you want to increase exposure.
